O.content: The leftmost dark-red bar is positioned above the x-axis label "Product E".
The y-axis is labeled "Units Sold"; visible labeled ticks include 10,000 and 20,000, and the top of the Product E bar lies between them, much closer to 10,000.

B.text: If the vertical axis labeled "Units Sold" is a linear quantitative scale with equal tick spacing, a bar's top decodes to its units-sold value; if Product E is within 2,000 units of the 12,500-unit policy decision threshold, the stated variance-band policy maps it to manual sales verification.
B.conditions: Assumes the Product E bar is bound to its x-axis label, the axis scale is linear, 12,500 is a decision threshold, and the manual-verification variance band applies when it overlaps other policy ranges.
